title: SEARCH AUTOCOMPLETE
subtitle: Suggestions on every keystroke within 100 ms: the work has to be done before anyone types.
footer: DDIA: Ch 11 batch-built indexes · Ch 12 trending counts   ·   Similar: Post search · Top-K videos

items: ~100k req/s at < 10 ms rules out queries: precompute top completions per prefix
Trie with top 10 at every node, in RAM, replicated
Streaming overlay for trends; client debounce and caches

blocks.text: Logs → Kafka → aggregate with decay → trie builder → snapshot → suggest servers; trending merged at serve time.
GROUP BY + LIKE per keystroke scans millions of rows.

items: Time-decayed popularity per language and region; personalise on the client.
Block list at serve time + spare candidates per node.
Fine for results pages; too costly per keystroke at this rate.

blocks.text: "Every node of an offline-built trie stores its top 10, so a suggestion is a 1 ms walk in memory; the client debounces, the CDN caches short prefixes, and a streaming job overlays trending queries."
